name: jessee
description: A native Mac recorder that turns narrated walkthroughs and imported videos into visual, AI-ready documents.

scripts.build:safari: npm run safari:resources && xcodebuild -project safari/JesSee.xcodeproj -scheme JesSee -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath safari/build build && node scripts/validate-safari-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:safari:unsigned: npm run safari:resources && xcodebuild -project safari/JesSee.xcodeproj -scheme JesSee -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath safari/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && node scripts/validate-safari-bundle.mjs
scripts.site:preview: npm run site:build && wrangler pages dev ./site-dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run site:build && wrangler pages deploy ./site-dist --project-name jessee --branch main
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:preview: npm run site:build && wrangler pages deploy ./site-dist --project-name jessee --branch preview
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
